CattleUSA: If you would like to buy online during our sales, it is broadcasted on CattleUSA. You need to be registered through CattleUSA AND Equity. Therefore, if you have not bought at an Equity market, please fill out our buyer application at any market or online and send it in at least 2 business days before the sale. We then can approve you to buy through CattleUSA. You will also need to register to bid at http://www.cattleusa.com
